analysis: Changes: (1) docs/reference/configuration.md adds one row at line 330 documenting DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED, a process-start env var that selects the Gated DeltaNet prompt-window kernel (stock, packed, rows, or a probe that keeps a four-row kernel only where it matches gated_delta_step bit for bit). It is documentation only and changes no code in this diff. The row says the var is read once per process and is not forwarded to LaunchAgents. Only a local operator can set it, and the operator is already ADV-001 inside TB-003. It is not a coordinator or consumer input, and it touches no A-001 key, attestation, or authorization paths (TB-011/T-053). Forced kernels skip the bit-exactness check and are described as A/B measurement only, so this relates to output integrity under T-007, where a malicious provider can already alter outputs. It adds no new capability. (2) The libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule pointer moves from 0351444e to 921bfa69. The diff supplies only the SHA change and no submodule content. I cannot verify what code the new pointer brings in, which is presumably the kernel implementation behind the new env var. That includes anything affecting the MLX inference engine (TB-007), prefix-cache KV state (T-041, T-028), or memory safety. This is a coverage limit, not evidence of safety. Remaining question for integration: confirm the submodule diff, especially GatedDelta.swift, preserves exactness in the default probe, adds no new env, file, or network access, and that the pointer is an intended reviewed commit. No concrete regression is identifiable from the supplied evidence.
